centerPortrait.limitation: Static serialized hierarchy only. A portrait-named GameObject or renderer binding does not prove the runtime selected character, pose, or live visibility.
centerPortrait.conclusion: No character portrait node, portrait renderer component, or portrait image reference was found in the complete 824-node SugarRunePopup hierarchy. RuneBack is decorative frame/silhouette artwork. Runtime-injected portrait content remains unknown.

layoutEvidence.layoutConclusion: Eight wedge-shaped runes use identical center anchor (0,-2), pivot (0.5,-0.160909), 132x228 Rects and successive 45-degree local rotations. Eight 998x70 stat rows are below the rune region; two 370x133 action buttons are below the list. The portrait-like RuneBack artwork is a frame/background asset, not by itself an identified character portrait.
layoutEvidence.coordinateLimit: Unity anchored positions and scale products are local prefab data, not observed device pixels. Runtime animation, parent Canvas scaling and layout groups may change final positions.

rotationField.explanation: No GameObject named RotateField exists in the bounded SugarRunePopup hierarchy; the actual wheel groups are RuneSlot/RuneSlotElements/Runes. Local anchor and scale data are retained verbatim.

runeBackLayout.basis: Arithmetic product of observed Rect size and local scale; parent Canvas/runtime transforms not applied.
